reason: Stems (0.2-)0.4-3(-4.6) dm converts to 4-30 cm with extremes 2 and 46 cm. For prostrate or decumbent stems, length is the right quality.
The leaf blade is abaxially usually glabrescent. Putting 'abaxially' on the abaxial surface follows the pattern, and 'usually' is kept as a frequency.

fix: 'mouth of corolla tube' / 'mouth of the X' should resolve to the mouth of the named organ, here the corolla throat (FLOPO_0986110), not the PO synonym match 'sporangium mouth' (PO_0030017). 'mouth' alone should be treated like 'throat' and 'orifice' (a part that needs its organ).
reason: Stamens are inserted at the throat of the corolla tube. The relation target is the moss/fern spore capsule mouth, which is false.
Blades rounded at the base. Mapping 'rounded' to obtuse is the accepted convention (union pair 'rounded or capitate'), and the bearer is the lamina base.

target: sepal margin (curled/rolled, on the overlapping side)
fix: 'à rebord enroulé' (with a rolled edge) puts the quality on the margin ('rebord'), not on the whole lobe. 'du côté recouvrant' limits it further to the overlapping side.
reason: The calyx lobes have a rolled margin on the covering side only. The lobe as a whole is not curled.
Major leaflet blades sometimes ± obovate. '±' is kept as approximately.
Follicles many-seeded: seeds present, many, in the fruit.
Leaves rather thickened: increased thickness of the leaf. 'Rather' is only a degree word.
Flowers opening widely into a star-like shape: the open flower is star-shaped.
Styles 3.

fix: In 'with white short curly hairs', the shape word describes the hairs. Crisped (FLOPO_0991148) is an edge-shape quality of a margin and must not be put on the part that carries the hairs.
reason: The inflorescence is hairy and the hairs are curly. The inflorescence is not crisped.

target: apiculate (a value, not the attribute sharpness PATO_0000944)
fix: In the PATO lexicon, 'apiculate' is a synonym of the attribute 'sharpness', so it is grounded as an attribute. Never use an attribute as one alternative value; same reason as the rejected union pair 'entire or apiculate'.
reason: The bract apices are mucronulate or apiculate. The second alternative became the bare attribute 'sharpness'.
In FNA, 'Plants 0.5-3 × 1-2 dm' is height × width. Height 5-30 cm is right.

fix: In a hyphenated shape compound 'A-B', the last word is the main shape (oblong-elliptic = elliptic tending to oblong). Grounding it as the first word, oblong, picks only the modifier.
reason: The range end 'oblong-elliptic' was grounded as plain oblong.
Stem leaves 4, whorled. 'Cauline' is kept as a context quality of the leaf.
Sepals with 1-3 veins visible when held to the light. A vein count inside the sepal is right.
Carpels united in fruit: connate, with the fruit development stage kept.
Seeds numerous.
Peduncles absent.
Stigma unlobed: not lobed.
Leaflet apex obtuse or acute. Putting the apex value on the whole part follows the existing FLOPO EQ convention (e.g. 'leaflet mucronate').
The scape (peduncle) is slightly shorter than the leaves.
Stems villous.

target: glabrous except at the vein axils; plus a barbate annotation at the vein axils
fix: 'X at P but otherwise glabrous' means glabrous everywhere except P. The exception must be kept, or the annotation reads as fully glabrous abaxially.
reason: The abaxial surface is bearded at the vein axils. A plain 'glabrous' on the whole abaxial surface is false.
Calyx segments (sepals) linear to lanceolate, read as a continuum.

fix: In 'hypanthium ..., in fruit red, depressed globose, 10-12 mm', the stage phrase 'in fruit' covers every value that follows in the same clause.
reason: Oblate is right for 'depressed globose', but the shape is the fruiting hypanthium (the hip), not the flowering one.
Aerial flowering stems 0.2-0.9 dm = 2-9 cm. Height of the erect stem fits.
Margins with 15-25 teeth on each side. The position slot is kept.
The perennating organs are pseudobulbous, and PO lists pseudobulb as a synonym of corm. Present is right.
Leaflet blade subacute at the apex. Putting the apex value on the whole part follows the existing FLOPO convention.
